node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double symmetric compiler
node.statement: Writing s_1,s_2,s_3 for the elementary symmetric functions of the three quadratic-fiber parameters, l_1,l_2,l_3 solve triangularly for s_1,V,s_3. The printed formulas for l_4,l_5,l_6 then give three exact equations in only (U,s_2,r,d); with the h=7 conic, the cubic 2+2+2 p-free core is a square four-equation system.
node.notes: Exact coefficient compiler only. Square counts equations and variables but is not a dimension or unit-ideal verdict; all color, norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.
